candidate_identity_rule: Every accepted packet binds the live convergence pull-request head commit, Git tree, canonical workflow run, exact-head source Artifact, and any applicable binary, provider, firmware, device, registry, and review identities. Any movement reopens the affected gate.
claim_ceiling: This program proves source-side preparation and enumerates authentic closure transactions. It does not close an Administration, provider, KMS/HSM, attestation, physical-device, firmware-vendor, independent-assurance, signing, pilot, rollout, rollback, store, or release gate without evidence issued and accepted by the named external authority.

gates.owner: Repository administrator plus a distinct governance observer
evidence_required: Administration-authorized apply receipt for every canonical protection field
Distinct complete sanitized API readback showing all seven exact required checks with strict=true
Ordinary protected merge receipt and fresh exact-main seven-job CI plus Artifact verification
acceptance: Every field in contracts/main-branch-protection-v1.json matches the live readback
No bypass actor, direct ref update, force push, review dismissal, or temporary relaxation was used
The adopted main commit and tree receive new exact-main evidence
prohibited_substitutes: screenshots without a complete API payload
repository-role admin without an Administration-capable API credential
administrator bypass or direct main ref movement
reopens_on: source, base, review, or main movement

evidence_required: Out-of-band authoritative registry digest and revision history
Narrow Ed25519 authority seats with identity verification and proof of private-key possession
Witnessed rotation, revocation, expiry, substitution, and cross-class negative drills
acceptance: The registry digest is distributed outside repository and evidence-bundle custody
No private key enters source, Actions, issues, pull requests, logs, or evidence packages
Complete external evidence validates under the independently pinned registry
prohibited_substitutes: pin derived from the submitted bundle
one key reused for incompatible authority classes
reopens_on: registry revision, key, scope, status, or pin movement
loss of proof-of-possession or controller independence

gates.owner: Eligible non-pusher Code Owner plus distinct external acceptance reviewer
evidence_required: Fresh exact-head GitHub approval by an eligible non-pusher
Externally signed review statement binding head, tree, run, Artifact, review ID, and resolved conversations
Distinct later acceptance bound to the final reviewer roster and acceptance context
acceptance: Reviewer eligibility and independence satisfy the authority contract
No source or base movement occurred after approval
The signed package validates under the out-of-band registry
reopens_on: source, base, workflow, Artifact, conversation, or reviewer-set movement

gates.owner: Affected credential provider and named security incident owner
evidence_required: Provider-side historical credential revocation receipt and authoritative timestamp
Negative-use proof that the old credential is unusable
Replacement opaque KID/reference, scoped policy, incident timeline, and closure approval
acceptance: The provider and incident owner sign the class-scoped claims
No raw credential or replacement secret is disclosed
Mobile and source artifacts contain no permanent provider credential
prohibited_substitutes: assertion that the key is unused
reopens_on: credential, tenant, scope, provider, environment, or incident finding movement

gates.owner: AI platform owner and cloud security owner
evidence_required: Production tenant, deployment, model, region, quota, retention, and training-use policy exports
KMS or secret-manager reference and redacted live success, rejection, timeout, cancel, quota, and revoke receipts
Independent confirmation that permanent provider secrets are absent from mobile binaries
acceptance: Live receipts bind to the declared tenant, deployment, candidate, and policy
Cancellation, deadline, rate, abuse, retention, and failure-closed controls are exercised
Artifact digests and owner approvals validate under the external registry
reopens_on: tenant, model, region, credential, quota, retention, deployment, or provider movement

gates.owner: KMS/HSM administrator, Android and Apple attestation owners, and cloud security
evidence_required: Production KMS/HSM key metadata, non-export policy, opaque KIDs, and deployment identity
Android and Apple attestation receipts bound to nonce, package or bundle, signer, device, freshness, and verdict policy
Rotation, revocation, replay, lost-device containment, and recovery drill receipts
acceptance: Private material remains non-exportable and outside source/mobile custody
Attestation receipts bind to the exact production applications and candidate
Independent assurance accepts rotation, revoke, replay, loss, and recovery behavior
prohibited_substitutes: local certificate or screenshot without issuer receipt
reopens_on: key, policy, region, application identity, signer, attestation policy, or recovery movement

gates.owner: Realtime platform and OAuth registration owners
evidence_required: Production realtime tenant and exact Android/iOS OAuth registration exports
Scope and redirect review plus one-time bootstrap, replay, stale, wrong-device, wrong-scope, and expiry receipts
Provider timeout reconciliation, user/provider revoke, and session termination receipts
acceptance: Mobile receives only bounded short-lived authority
Single consumption is atomic under concurrency
Every receipt binds to the declared tenant, applications, scopes, candidate, and provider
reopens_on: tenant, redirect, scope, provider, bootstrap, revoke, or application identity movement

gates.owner: Capability platform, provider integration, and privacy owners
evidence_required: Per-enabled-adapter application registration, minimum scopes, consent, opaque credential handle, and policy records
Live success, rejection, duplicate, timeout, reconciliation, revoke, retention, export, deletion, and redaction receipts
Provider-authoritative external IDs and privacy-owner approval
acceptance: Single-use mutation authority is consumed before the first external effect
Indeterminate effects reconcile through authoritative provider reads
Disabled adapters remain unavailable and enabled adapters satisfy purpose limitation
prohibited_substitutes: declaring an enabled adapter not applicable
reopens_on: adapter enablement, provider, scope, consent, credential, retention, or policy movement

gates.owner: Independent or controlled device lab plus Android/iOS release owners
evidence_required: Signed Android and iOS test-build digests and declared handset, OS, G1 hardware, firmware, RF, locale, and instrumentation matrix
Raw acquisition-order synthetic=false traces and derived protocol, latency, reliability, power, thermal, cancellation, recovery, and soak reports
Lab signature, operator identity, SLO evaluation, and independent acceptance
acceptance: Both platforms pass the canonical physical evaluator and minimum sample floors
Fault observation and recovery are demonstrated rather than labeled
Reports bind to the exact binaries, devices, firmware, scenario, and lab authority
prohibited_substitutes: unsigned screenshot or single-device sample represented as a matrix
reopens_on: binary, signer, handset, OS, G1 hardware, firmware, RF, scenario, lab, or SLO movement

gates.owner: Production speech provider, mobile audio owner, and physical lab
evidence_required: Production Android PCM-to-ASR deployment and provider/KMS references
Physical Android/iOS device, OS, locale, G1 firmware, latency, finality, cancellation, interruption, and privacy reports
Provider retention, training-use, regional processing, delete, abuse, and observability controls
acceptance: Only provider/framework-final text can become final application output
Barge-in and cancellation fence stale transcript, model, and display publication
Raw audio and partial transcripts remain bounded to the active session
reopens_on: speech provider, tenant, audio format, locale, OS, device, firmware, retention, or binary movement

gates.owner: Independent assurance leads separate from implementation and evidence production
evidence_required: Independent security, privacy, legal, accessibility, and safety reports bound to the same candidate and binaries
Reviewer qualification and independence declarations, executed test plans, findings, retests, and residual-risk decisions
Detached signatures or verifiable review receipts and final cross-discipline acceptance
acceptance: All required disciplines approve the same unchanged candidate
High and critical findings are resolved and other residual risks are accepted by authorized owners
Reviewers are not source pushers or evidence issuers for the approved area
prohibited_substitutes: generic compliance certificate or approval of different digests
reopens_on: candidate, binary, provider, firmware, threat model, material finding, reviewer, or acceptance movement

gates.owner: Even G1 firmware vendor or explicitly delegated firmware authority
evidence_required: Vendor grant defining products, hardware revisions, firmware branches, roles, scope, and validity
Reproducible firmware build, secure-boot chain, HSM/KMS signing custody, OTA, anti-rollback, recovery, and compatibility records
Witnessed authorized-image, tamper rejection, interrupted OTA, recovery, rollback, and key retirement drills
acceptance: Issuer authority is verifiably vendor-authorized
Lifecycle drills pass on the declared physical hardware
Independent assurance accepts the vendor evidence and companion-app boundary
prohibited_substitutes: public firmware binary or local dump
reopens_on: vendor grant, hardware, firmware, boot chain, signer, OTA, recovery, rollback, or protocol movement

gates.owner: Android/iOS signing authorities, release engineering, pilot, rollback, and store owners
evidence_required: Production-signed Android and iOS binaries, public signer metadata, binary SBOMs, provenance, attestations, entitlements, and final scans
Executed pilot, support, incident, kill-switch, rollback, reliability, latency, power, thermal, crash, privacy, and accessibility results
Staged rollout decisions, exact-binary store or distribution approvals, and a passing no-override product release gate
acceptance: All artifacts bind to one frozen candidate, provider, firmware, policy, and binary set
Pilot and rollback thresholds are executed and accepted by named authorities
Store approvals identify the exact submitted binaries and the product release gate passes without override
prohibited_substitutes: source SBOM represented as binary SBOM
unexecuted kill switch or rollback plan
store submission without approval or release-gate override
reopens_on: source, binary, signer, entitlement, provider, firmware, configuration, pilot, rollout, rollback, store, or finding movement
